paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between original Consistency-CE model and ours proposed Consistency-Bi model for wait-1 testing under prefix-constrained decoding setting.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the comparison of BLEU scores across varying lengths of a gold prefix for two different models. The x-axis, labeled "the length of gold prefix," utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20 with numeric tick labels positioned at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU," employs a linear scale ranging from 23 to 29 with tick labels at intervals of 1, accompanied by horizontal dashed grid lines corresponding to each tick mark. The plot features two lines representing different data series, as indicated by a legend in the bottom right corner. The series labeled "Consistency-CE" is represented by a blue dashed line with empty circular markers. It begins at an x-value of 0 with a y-value of approximately 24.6, drops sharply to roughly 23.7 at x=1, rises to about 24.9 at x=2, and dips to 24.5 at x=3. Following this initial fluctuation, the line exhibits a steady upward trend, passing through approximately 25.9 at x=10 and concluding at its maximum value of roughly 28.1 at x=20. The second series, labeled "Consistency-Bi," is depicted by an orange solid line with filled red square markers. It starts at x=0 at a higher y-value of approximately 27.6, fluctuates slightly upwards to reach its peak at roughly 28.1 at x=5, and subsequently demonstrates a continuous, steady decline across the remainder of the graph. It falls to roughly 26.4 at x=10, 24.7 at x=15, and ends near its lowest point of approximately 24.0 at x=20.
